about_short_description.short_description: Tenable is a cloud-native application protection platform company that helps prevent breaches by analyzing configurations across identities.

product.name: Cloud Infrastructure Entitlement Management
product.description: Manages human and machine identities with visibility into access risks, overprivileged and unused entitlements across multiple clouds.

product.name: Cloud Workload Protection
product.description: Scans and visualizes critical risks in workloads, including vulnerabilities and misconfigurations in virtual machines, containers, and serverless functions.

product.name: CSPM
product.description: Detects and remediates misconfigurations and complies with industry standards by defining and enforcing custom policies for cloud configuration and IAM.

product.name: Kubernetes Security Posture Management
product.description: Secures Kubernetes clusters by revealing, prioritizing, and remediating security gaps and automating compliance across cloud infrastructure.

product.name: Infrastructure as Code Scanning
product.description: Scans infrastructure as code to detect and fix flaws, revealing prioritized cloud risks and notifying teams via integrations.

product.name: Network Visualization
product.description: Visualizes resources exposed to public access due to network misconfiguration and limits access to resources.
